scope: Remove the per-chunk temporary string allocation from SAT text group emission while preserving ASCII/Binary DXF wire semantics.

implementation.behavior: writeDxfSatTextValue encodes a maximum 255-character group in a fixed stack buffer and passes a synchronous string_view to dxfWriter. Existing input validation, SAT-v1 transformation, atomic caret escaping, first-group selection, subsequent group-3 selection, and write-error propagation are preserved.
